findings.problem: hatua ya kuathiriwa does not explain exposure and the noun total health obscures signed health change; source applies outside a building.
findings.suggested_correction: Mabadiliko ya afya yenye ishara chanya au hasi kwa kila hatua kiumbe akiwa nje ya jengo, yakigawanywa kwa 256; thamani hasi hudhuru viumbe.
findings.context: src/unit/Unit.cpp:367–395 excludes units inside/entering/leaving attached buildings from terrain health change.

findings.problem: Alama za afya ... kwa hatua ya kuathiriwa is unclear about both signed change and exposure outside buildings.
